gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma Multiforme of Brain; Glioma, Sarcomatous
Subject has pathologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma or gliosarcoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Intravenous injection of Photobac® 24 hours before surgical removal of recurrent GBMF.
Lighting up the brain using a low power near infrared laser will kill cells that contain Photobac®.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subject has recurrent or progressive tumor following standard therapy.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Measure Photobac® concentration in tumor tissue removed during resection and in the bed of the tumor both before and after ligh treatment.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Measure Stat 3 Crosslinking as a quantitative marker of singlet oxygen tissue damage
The samples of tissue taken from the tumor bed will be assayed for the degree of stat 3 crosslinking.

role_evidence.quote: 3-(1-Butyloxy)ethyl-3-deacetyl-bacteriopurpurin-18-n-butylimide methyl ester (Photobac®) is injected 24 hours prior to surgical resection of a recurrent Glioblastoma or gliosarcoma.
Immediately following the resection the cavity is treated with 50 joules/ square cm of 787 nm light

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational bacteriochlorin photosensitizer for photodynamic therapy: 3-(1-Butyloxy)ethyl-3-deacetyl-bacteriopurpurin-18-n-butylimide methyl ester
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Photodynamic therapy: photosensitizer retained in tumour, activated by near-infrared (787 nm) light to kill cells via singlet oxygen damage
arms: Photochemotherapy as an adjuvant to surgical resection of glioblastoma

biomarkers.biomarker_other: STAT3 crosslinking in tumour bed tissue (marker of singlet oxygen damage)

source_quote.quote: Stat3 crosslinking is caused by singlet oxygen damage and is expected correlate with the PDT dose.

coder_notes: Photobac is a brand-like name; no INN given in record, so active_moiety uses the name as first written (photobac) with the chemical name in drug_class_hint. Drug-device (laser PDT) -> device_dependent true. Prior RT/TMZ is history, not a backbone. Plasma PK also planned (blood/serum).
